summary: Kandal M Venture Limited, a Cambodian contract manufacturer of leather goods, filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing its full fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 financial results via press release. The filing includes revenue of US$17.1 million, a slight 0.3% decline year-over-year, and a gross profit margin of 18.9%. Management discusses securing a growth capital facility for equipment and tech upgrades in Cambodia and the Philippines. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No deal terms are disclosed; the filing is purely operational and financial reporting.
